documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Approval Of Unaudited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results For The Quarter Ended September 30, 2026
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of Postal_Ballot
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Manorama Industries Limited reported a strong Q1 FY27 with a 39.5% year-on-year revenue growth and crossed INR 4,000 million in quarterly revenue and EBITDA, driven by a richer product mix of value-added offerings and higher traction in fractionation capacity. Management highlighted strategic expansions including a new sourcing subsidiary in Chad, land acquisition in Burkina Faso for processing facilities, and a completed QIP to strengthen the balance sheet. Looking ahead, the company remains confident in long-term demand and plans ongoing capex investments in solvent fractionation, refinery, and backward integration to drive sustainable growth. Manorama Industries reported strong performance for Q1 FY27, driven by sustained demand across key end-user industries and contributions from its specialty fats portfolio. The company achieved a 39.5% year-on-year growth in total quarterly revenue and a 67.6% surge in profit after tax.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that demand remains sustained across end-use industries with deeper customer relationships.
demand_outlook.quote: Our profitability grew by 67.6% year-on-year, reflecting sustained demand across the end use industries, deeper customer relationships and the increasing contribution of our value-added specialty fats and butters portfolio.

demand_outlook.claim: The company continues to witness sustained and growing demand worldwide across the food and cosmetic sectors for specialty fats and coco butter equivalents.
demand_outlook.quote: This excellence in performance is a testament to the resilience of our integrated value chain, the global relevance of our specialty fats and coco butter equivalents and the sustained and growing demand we continue to witness across the food and cosmetic sectors worldwide through our scientific and high-tech products, which are being used all over the world.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its sourcing footprint in West Africa through the incorporation of Manorama Savannah Agro Chad Sarl.
capex_expansion.quote: We expanded our sourcing footprint in West Africa through the incorporation of Manorama Savannah Agro Chad Sarl in Chad, our wholly owned subsidiary in Chad.

capex_expansion.claim: Manorama Industries acquired approximately 10 hectares, 24 acres of land in Burkina Faso for a shea nut and mango nut processing facility with regulatory approvals currently in progress.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition, we acquired approximately 10 hectares, 24 acres of land in Burkina Faso for a shea nut and mango nut processing facility with regulatory approvals currently in the progress.

capex_expansion.claim: The company anticipates the solvent fractionation 3 and refinery to be commissioned around Q3 of FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: So on the solvent fractionation 3 and our refinery are being targeted for commissioning around FY 28, around Q3 of that financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: Management expects total capex investment to be around INR 225 crores to INR 250 crores in financial year 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: So ballpark capex guidance for this year should be around INR 225 crores to INR 250-odd crores of investment in financial year approximately in FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary, Manorama Savannah Agro Chad SARL, in the Republic of Chad to strengthen its Shea sourcing network.
capex_expansion.quote: To strengthen its Shea sourcing network in West Africa, the Company incorporated Manorama Savannah Agro Chad SARL, a wholly owned subsidiary in Chad.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired approximately 10 hectares of land in Burkina Faso for its Shea seed processing facility, with regulatory approvals currently underway.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, we acquired ~10 hectares (24 acres) of land in Burkina Faso for our Shea seed processing facility, with regulatory approvals currently underway, further enhancing supply chain integration and proximity to key customers.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans a strategic capital expenditure commitment of approximately INR 460 crores over the next two to three years.
capex_expansion.quote: Through strategic capital expenditure commitment of approximately INR 460 crores over the next two to three years, this investment program spans setting up of a new solvent fractionation manufacturing facility for Sal, Shea, Palm, Mango and other exotic seeds and ESOS.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin expanded by 326 basis points to 19.5% for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax increased by 67.6% year-on-year, that is INR 79 crores with profit after tax margin expanding by 326 basis points to 19.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Full year EBITDA was INR 367.7 crores with an EBITDA margin of 27.1%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA INR 367.7 crores with an EBITDA margin of 27.1%, reflecting focused product mix optimization and disciplined cost management.

orders_capacity.claim: The company completed a portion of additional fractionation capacity of 7,500 tons which is already operationalized, with balance debottlenecking intended for Q3 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: So we already have done a portion of our additional capacity of 7,500, which is already have been operationalized. And the balance is intended to be implemented in a manner during FY27 around Quarter 3 of this financial year, subject to operational time lines.

orders_capacity.claim: Existing capacity utilization stands at approximately 85% of 40,000 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Existing capacity are on a utilization level of 85% of 40,000 tons.

capital_allocation.claim: The successful completion of a qualified institutional placement (QIP) strengthened the company's balance sheet and provided financial flexibility.
capital_allocation.quote: The successful completion of our qualified institutional placement, QIP, marks another important milestone, strengthening our balance sheet and providing the financial flexibility to accelerate growth across manufacturing, sourcing and high value-added segments.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash flow from operating activities stood at INR 259 crores for FY 26.
capital_allocation.quote: Net cash flow from operating activities stood at INR 259 crores, ROCE of 33.6% and ROE of 40.3%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Nigeria put a temporary export ban on shea nuts, which management stated does not materially impact their sourcing strategy due to a vast presence across Africa.
risks_headwinds.quote: So that is one country which has put a temporary ban. So that doesn't materially impact our sourcing strategy from there because our presence in that geography area is vast, which is substantial in Africa region.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the solvent fractionation 3 and refinery are being targeted for commissioning around Q3 of FY28.
management_commitments.quote: So on the solvent fractionation 3 and our refinery are being targeted for commissioning around FY 28, around Q3 of that financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company anticipates spending approximately INR 225 crores to INR 250 crores in capex during FY27.
management_commitments.quote: So ballpark capex guidance for this year should be around INR 225 crores to INR 250-odd crores of investment in financial year approximately in FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The balance of the debottlenecking capacity is intended to be implemented during FY27 around Quarter 3.
management_commitments.quote: And the balance is intended to be implemented in a manner during FY27 around Quarter 3 of this financial year, subject to operational time lines.
